The single stock delta remains correct, but the overlapping replay must return documented 200 with the original transaction. Original 10 scoped native tests pass; add a deterministic multi-session regression for this exact interleaving, fix replay-versus-version ordering, and retain tenant isolation, immutable ledger and no duplicated stock delta. tasks.title: Repair equipment replay and concurrency
scope: services/api/equipment task-local migrations, tests and documentation only
acceptance: An authorized operator retry of a previously successful identical equipment edit returns its original successful result without another write or event. Replays bind to the verified tenant, actor, exact normalized request and target; changed payload or cross-actor/tenant key misuse safely conflicts or denies. Membership and permission revocation are respected.

Keep existing general audit-log restrictions, policies and grants unchanged; do not broaden equipment_event SELECT access. A task-local immutable private receipt design is acceptable, with truthful legacy-key limitations.
Replay after an intervening administrative edit returns the original snapshot rather than the new current state. Successful no-op receipt behavior is explicit.

Fix the reproduced native PostgreSQL locking failure: concurrent observation A changes equipment.location_id while B waits on joined SELECT FOR UPDATE; after A commits, B must not falsely return 404 or drop its legitimate newer observation. Lock equipment independently then perform a fresh joined read, or use another proven correct solution preserving atomicity and location freshness.
State, audit and receipt writes roll back atomically on conflicts or failures; no duplicate updates, fabricated real hardware or patient data, or replacement of the existing generated NICU assets.
verification: Scoped tests with actual native PostgreSQL multi-session same-key and same-version races
